title: Agent identity, plus context and memory: three IANA-registered formats
content:
Why Agents Need a Passport: .fafa — Portable Identity for the Agentic Era
Description
This paper specifies .fafa (application/vnd.fafa+yaml), the IANA-registered media type for declarative agent identity: a portable passport for who an agent is, what it may do, where it is reached, and what it must never do. It complements Agent Cards, Model Context Protocol server-cards, and AGENTS.md; it does not replace them.
In production, that identity is usually inferred from system prompts, product settings, and protocol-native cards that do not travel cleanly across hosts — seam rewrites, inference cost, and trust surfaces that cannot be diffed. A .fafa document is simple, structured, and persistent. Its lifecycle is author → serve → discover → project. House cards stay the wire format; AGENTS.md stays the repo ops briefing; .fafa answers who the agent is. The paper is self-contained. Multi-agent orchestration, deep composition, and scoring are deferred.

report.summary: IANA注册三种格式，为AI智能体提供统一身份、上下文和记忆标准化方案。
report.background: 随着多智能体系统普及，智能体身份、上下文和记忆缺乏可移植的标准化格式，导致系统提示词难跨平台复用、信任评估困难。Wolf等人先后提出.faf（上下文）、.fafm（记忆），并最终发布.fafa智能体身份护照，三者均获IANA媒体类型注册。.fafa以声明式YAML定义智能体身份、权限与禁用行为，补充而非替代Agent Cards、MCP server-cards和AGENTS.md，旨在让智能体身份像护照一样跨主机流转。
key_points: .fafa是IANA注册的智能体身份媒体类型，用YAML声明智能体身份、能力范围、访问地址与禁止事项。
生命周期为作者→发布→发现→投影，身份文档可从单一来源导出到不同运行时环境。
与.faf（上下文）、.fafm（记忆）组成三件套，分别解决身份、上下文与记忆的标准化问题。
不取代现有协议，而是与Agent Cards、MCP server-cards和AGENTS.md互补，专注回答“智能体是谁”。
report.impact: 对AI行业：推动智能体互操作性，降低多平台迁移成本，为信任和审计提供基础。对开发者：简化智能体配置，无需从系统提示中推断身份，利于调试和团队协作。对普通用户：智能体行为边界更清晰，使用更透明，可基于统一身份格式评估可信度。
report.tools: 可关注.faf系列规范（GitHub: Wolfe-Jam/faf），以及配合使用的MCP（Model Context Protocol）、A2A Agent Card和AGENTS.md。这些工具共同构成智能体上下文、记忆和身份管理的参考实践。
